rule_set_yaml:
# Baseline fraud policy. Rules are CEL expressions evaluated by the Java scoring core (dev.cel:cel)
# and re-evaluated by the Python verifier (common-expression-language) with identical bindings:
#   f      map<string, double>  every feature in contracts/features/feature_schema.yaml
#   event  map<string, dyn>     TransactionEvent fields; enums by name, integers as int
# Feature values are doubles: compare with double literals (3.0, not 3).
#
# Precedence (first that applies wins):
#   DECLINE rule > ALLOW rule > score >= decline
#   > CHALLENGE rule (REVIEW when the payment cannot be stepped up) > score >= challenge (challengeable only)
#   > REVIEW rule > score >= review > APPROVE
# On the rules-only fallback path (model/feature deadline), score is ignored and the decision is
# flagged degraded.
#
# v4: step-up. A card authorisation cannot wait for an analyst: a REVIEW approves it and the case is
# worked afterwards (contracts/insights.yaml review_holds), so the real in-line controls are a
# step-up (3DS / SCA challenge online, PIN prompt in store) and a decline. v4 steps up the card
# review band and the card review rules; transfers stay held for review (a call-back beats an in-app
# confirmation against scams: victims authorise their own payment). Tuned with
# `pulsebench rules-whatif` on fraud-train (seed 7), confirmed out of sample on fraud-eval (seed 1337,
# every event), against v3:
#   fraud stopped 0.854 -> 0.889; fraud $ paid $493k -> $387k (-22%); merchant-breach stopped
#   0.34 -> 0.83, ATO 0.43 -> 0.52, card testing 0.80 -> 0.84; good customers reviewed 4,774 -> 2,541;
#   cost: 0.76% of good customers challenged, 176 abandoned ($120k of lost sales). APP scam and ATM
#   unchanged. A band at 0.65 instead of 0.55 let more card testing through on fraud-train.
#
# v5: v4 + CVV_FAILURES. Card-number guessing shows up as repeated CVV failures on one card (schema v2
# authorisation signals). Tuned on fraud-train (seed 7; >= 2 beat >= 3 at the same precision),
# confirmed out of sample on fraud-eval (seed 1337, every event, rules-whatif): 256 fires at precision
# 0.977, 0.002% of good customers; card-testing fraud $ paid $17.6k -> $9.9k (stopped 0.908 -> 0.928),
# all fraud $ paid $290.6k -> $282.9k, good customers declined 0.144% -> 0.146%.
version: baseline-v5
thresholds:
  review: 0.55
  challenge: 0.55
  decline: 0.90
challenge:
  # which payments can be stepped up: online card payments (3DS / SCA), chip and contactless in store
  # (PIN prompt). Not: recurring / card-on-file (no customer present), ATM (the PIN is already in),
  # magstripe fallback, keyed (MOTO) and wallet tokens, and transfers (held for review instead).
  when: "!event.recurring && event.channel != 'ATM' && event.entry_mode in ['ECOM_3DS', 'ECOM_NON_3DS', 'CHIP', 'CONTACTLESS']"
rules:
  - id: CARD_TESTING
    when: "f.card_small_cnp_count_10m >= 3.0"
    action: DECLINE
    reason: ">=3 small card-not-present authorisations on the card in 10 minutes"
  - id: CARD_TESTING_MERCHANT
    when: "f.merch_small_cnp_count_5m >= 25.0 && event.amount_usd_minor < 200"
    action: CHALLENGE
    reason: "merchant is receiving a burst of small CNP authorisations"
  - id: VELOCITY_CARD_5M
    when: "f.card_count_5m > 6.0"
    action: CHALLENGE
    reason: "more than 6 transactions on the card in 5 minutes"
  - id: VELOCITY_CARD_10M_DISTINCT
    when: "f.card_distinct_merchants_10m >= 5.0"
    action: CHALLENGE
    reason: "card used at 5+ distinct merchants in 10 minutes"
  - id: IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL
    when: "event.card_present && f.card_geo_speed_kmh > 900.0"
    action: DECLINE
    reason: "card-present transactions implying travel faster than 900 km/h"
  - id: MAGSTRIPE_FOREIGN
    when: "event.entry_mode == 'MAGSTRIPE' && f.is_foreign > 0.5"
    action: REVIEW
    reason: "magstripe fallback abroad (counterfeit indicator)"
  - id: CONTACTLESS_SPLIT
    when: "f.card_contactless_count_30m >= 4.0 && f.card_contactless_sum_30m > 20000.0"
    action: CHALLENGE
    reason: "repeated contactless payments just under the CVM limit"
  - id: ATO_NEW_DEVICE_HIGH_AMOUNT
    when: "f.cust_device_novel > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 300.0 && f.is_cnp > 0.5"
    action: CHALLENGE
    reason: "high-value remote purchase from a device never seen for this customer"
  # v3: ATO_NEW_DEVICE_NEW_COUNTRY removed (it was DECLINE in v1, REVIEW in v2). Replayed with
  # `pulsebench rules-whatif`, tuned on fraud-train (seed 7) and confirmed on fraud-eval (seed 1337):
  # precision 0.036 over 9,618 fires on the evaluation world, 3.15% of all legitimate customers sent to
  # review. Removing it: review rate (FPR) 4.13% -> 1.79%, flagged recall 0.919 -> 0.915, fraud $ approved
  # +$3.7k of $2.86M. New device + new IP country stays a model input (the model weighs it with the
  # amount, the merchant and the hour); ATO_NEW_DEVICE_HIGH_AMOUNT keeps the remote high-value case.
  - id: ATM_VELOCITY
    when: "f.card_atm_count_1h >= 3.0"
    action: DECLINE
    reason: "3+ ATM withdrawals on the card within an hour"
  - id: ATM_TERMINAL_CASHOUT
    when: "f.is_atm > 0.5 && f.term_atm_sum_1h > 500000.0"
    action: REVIEW
    reason: "terminal dispensed > $5,000 within an hour"
  - id: APP_SCAM_NEW_PAYEE
    when: "f.is_transfer > 0.5 && f.cust_payee_novel > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 1000.0"
    action: REVIEW
    reason: "large transfer to a payee never paid before"
  - id: MULE_FAN_IN
    when: "f.is_transfer > 0.5 && f.payee_distinct_senders_24h >= 6.0"
    action: DECLINE
    reason: "payee received transfers from 6+ distinct senders in 24h (mule pattern)"
  - id: BOT_DEVICE_MANY_CARDS
    when: "f.dev_distinct_cards_1h >= 4.0"
    action: DECLINE
    reason: "device used with 4+ distinct cards in an hour"
  - id: BUST_OUT_UTILISATION
    when: "f.credit_utilisation_24h > 0.8 && f.amount_to_avg_ratio > 8.0"
    action: REVIEW
    reason: "credit line nearly exhausted in 24h with outsized ticket"
  - id: CVV_FAILURES
    when: "f.card_cvv_fail_count_1h >= 2.0"
    action: DECLINE
    reason: "repeated CVV failures on the card within an hour (card-number guessing)"
